answer: Proof of Stake acts as a gale against Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital, creating a prohibitive cost for identity inflation. Like a ship tied to a wharf, an agent must tether economic value to its address to gain network influence. Without this bond, an agent is just a mirror reflecting empty pseudonyms; however, by imposing a financial penalty on malicious behavior, the system forces attackers to risk real assets, rendering the creation of infinite identities economically irrational.
